long_beta.scope_text: The desk's small-cap long lanes counted together: 1W Cyan & Green, 1W Cyan small caps, Daily Cyan, 1D Green. Filled holdings only, at broker marks. 1H Swing and other holdings are not part of this group.
long_beta.method_text: Beta shows how strongly these holdings have moved with IWM, from about three months of daily closes per holding, weighted by market value. A beta of 1 means one-for-one with small caps. IWM-equivalent = market value times beta: the part of the exposure that behaves like simply owning IWM.
long_beta.history_text: Recorded once per market day starting Oct 5, 2026. There is no per-lane history before that, so earlier days are not shown.
